detailed_description:
The target video is a 10-second horizontal 16:9 realistic sneaker seeding video seen entirely as the reflection in a full-length LED dressing mirror, shot as a HANDHELD PHONE mirror-selfie with natural subtle wobble throughout, authentic phone feel, one continuous take with zero cuts. The room is bathed in AMPLE, BRIGHT, SOFT even warm-white light plus the warm vertical LED glow along the mirror, no harsh shadows, airy and clean. The woman's lower body from <Subject 1> stands on the round cream-white shaggy rug at the left in black flared long trousers, fair slender ankles, pink-coral toenails, barefoot; the UNC blue-white low-top sneakers from <Subject 2> rest on the rug directly in front of her feet, separated into an outer shoe and an inner shoe aligned with her feet.
[Shot 1] At 0.00s, ON THE VERY FIRST FRAME, the off-screen female narrator (S1) immediately begins in the exact voice timbre referenced from <Audio 1> (timbre only; new words, natural relaxed sharing tone, about 50 characters total) and KEEPS TALKING CONTINUOUSLY, with no silent gap, through every action until the video ends: <d>[Chinese] 姐妹们看这双上脚效果，蓝白配色干净清爽，正面显脚小，侧面线条流畅，鞋底很轻走路不累，搭裤子裙子都好看，特别百搭。</d> The opening frame shows both sneakers grounded and in clear view (2 loose, 0 worn) in front of her bare feet, mirror frame and LED strip visible, room bright and soft, the voice already present.
From ~0.00s to ~1.50s she readies her stance, the flared trouser hems shifting slightly, both shoes still, the voiceover continuing.
From ~1.50s to ~3.20s the OUTER FOOT travels STRAIGHT into the OUTER SHOE on its own side — no crossing — while that shoe stays grounded; the foot slides fully in, adjusts once naturally, and only then lifts the shoe worn on the outer foot, its spot now empty. The inner foot stays bare and still, the inner shoe stays grounded (1 worn + 1 loose = 2); narration continues over the action.
From ~3.20s to ~4.50s the INNER FOOT travels STRAIGHT into the INNER SHOE on its own side — no crossing, no reaching across — the grounded shoe receives the foot, a small natural adjustment, then it lifts worn on the inner foot, its spot empty; now both sneakers are correctly paired (2 worn + 0 loose), rug clear of loose shoes, no teleport or duplication; narration continues.
From ~4.50s to ~6.50s she walks forward to the CENTER of the mirror frame at a normal natural pace, blue-white sneakers stepping across the cream shaggy rug, flared hems swaying lightly, handheld wobble re-centering her in the mirror; the voiceover continues without pause.
From ~6.50s to ~10.00s, centered, she showcases the sneakers from DIFFERENT ANGLES through ONE SMOOTH CONTINUOUS ROTATION on small pivoting steps: starting front (toe boxes, laces and side swooshes to the mirror, held a beat), rotating evenly through a three-quarter angle to a pure SIDE view held a beat (profile, midsole, outsole blocks), continuing through the other three-quarter angle to show the opposite side and heel, then rotating back to FRONT through every intermediate facing with no snap or jump, with an optional small toe-tap / slight foot lift to show the sole and perforated toe detail. The continuous voiceover lands its final words "特别百搭" exactly on the closing front pose and finishes at 10.00s as the video ends — the narrator has spoken from the first frame to the last with no silent gap. The end frame is a front view, outer shoe on the outer foot and inner shoe on the inner foot, no loose shoes, sneakers in clear view under the bright soft light. Throughout: one unbroken mirror-selfie take, zero cuts, same-side near pairing with no crossing, total shoes always 2, continuous rotation with no orientation jump, natural handheld wobble, continuous voiceover from 0.00s to 10.00s, and ample bright soft even lighting matching <Picture 1>.
